item.text: I’ll build a single-file site with illustrated case studies, a complete featured essay, tag filtering, and a light/dark theme switch.

The design uses warm paper tones, red accents, and original SVG illustrations for the four projects. I’m adding the full essay, keeping navigation visible on mobile, and making the project and writing links open readable details.

item.text: The page is written, including the essay and responsive layouts. I’m checking the links, theme switch, and tag filters. The newsletter form validates email addresses and explains that this preview has no mailing service connected.
